composition_label: Feedback analysis (Customer insights) -> Behavioral personalization (Personalized discovery)

construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated standard-library Python reference implementation

shared_schema.input: Object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, timezone-aware as_of, user_id, ERP/MES work_orders[], quality_inspections[], sensor_csv string, feedback[], events[]. Each entity list has unique nonempty ids.
shared_schema.work_order: id, asset_id, description, status=open|closed, known theme tags[], tolerances keyed by metric with unit,min,max,safety_max
shared_schema.event: id,user_id,work_order_id,type=browse|purchase,timestamp. Purchase represents procurement engagement associated with an order, not a production action.
shared_schema.output: Versioned envelope containing validated input, deduplicated feedback with evidence and inspection decision trace, human escalations and personalized behavior rankings; status=ok. Errors return status=error and message, exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: validate() is the shared stage boundary. Feedback and final output are checked against deterministic reconstruction. Foreign keys, asset matching, finite numeric values, timestamps not in future, explicit units and ordered tolerances enforced.

cross_stage_handoffs: feedback_stage validates input and returns a validated shared envelope.
behavior_stage accepts only the validated feedback envelope, not independent raw feedback.
Deduplicated feedback themes augment order tags for behavior affinity; unique feedback groups contribute priority, while duplicate evidence does not multiply priority.
Feedback group and supporting source ids propagate into ranked explanations; safety escalations propagate unchanged even for closed orders.

behavior.deduplication: Per work order, Unicode word normalization and case folding; deterministic smallest-id representative; retain all exact source excerpts and inspection references; safety flags ORed.
behavior.themes: Fixed keyword vocabulary: thermal,vibration,quality,maintenance,safety; unmatched text becomes general. No model or LLM needed.
behavior.recency: Event weight = browse 1 or purchase 3 multiplied by 2^(-age_days/30), using explicit as_of; only current user's events.
behavior.ranking: Score = direct weighted order engagement + sum of matching theme profile weights + 0.25 per unique feedback group. Order-id tie break, scores rounded to eight decimals; only open orders ranked.
behavior.cold_start: No current-user events: feedback-priority ranking; without feedback, stable work-order-id order. No invented personal history or cross-user profiling.
behavior.quality_trace: Every recorded quality decision exposes inspector, timestamp, asset, work order, metric, value, unit, reason and applied tolerance. Decision must match measured bounds. Demonstrates ISO 9001-style traceability, not certification.
behavior.safety: Explicit safety-critical feedback, safety vocabulary, or sensor/inspection value >= safety_max produces a human_review_required alert. Advisory only; automatic_execution_allowed is always false. High readings never revise earlier inspection decisions.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic invented assets, orders, quality records and maintenance logs. Seed 16 Gaussian randomized physically plausible telemetry with a deliberate bounded safety excursion.

included: Manufacturing tolerance validation and human escalation
Unit tests and CLI subprocess tests
excluded: Equipment actuation or automatic quality release
Live providers, LLMs or network calls
Fuzzy semantic deduplication or trained machine learning
Lower-bound safety alarms: this demonstrator models explicit safety flags and upper-limit alarms only

verified: Both stages and exact validated handoff
Cold start, user isolation and deterministic ties
Invalid units, tolerances, decisions, references, times and numbers
CLI success, validation, missing-file and usage failures
